name: Remix
long_description:
Remix’s mission is to help build more livable cities. Our software helps city planners understand their communities and design transportation systems that serve them. We’ve partnered with over 325 cities across 20 countries on 4 continents — and were continually seeking to grow our impact around the world.

Urban planning impacts everything from economic mobility to CO2 emissions, and our platform empowers local governments to transform their transportation systems, design safer streets, and implement new mobility options to better serve their communities.
one_liner: We’re building a platform to empower cities to plan the best possible…

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Tiffany Chu is the former CEO & Co-founder of Remix. She has been named in Forbes' 30 Under 30, LinkedIn's Next Wave of Leaders Under 35, World Economic Forum's Tech Pioneers, and more. Previously, Tiffany was a Fellow at Code for America, the first UX hire at Zipcar, served as Commissioner of the San Francisco Department of the Environment, and has a background in architecture and urban planning from MIT. Remix was acquired by Via in 2021.
